name: SweepBright
positioning: A mobile-first agency CRM for European markets — capture a property on site, publish it before leaving.
description: SweepBright is a real estate agency platform used across Belgium, France and other European markets: property and contact management, mobile listing capture with photos, matching, multi-portal publishing, digital signature and an agency website module.
real_estate_use: The design assumption is that the agent is never at a desk. Capturing the property during the valuation visit — rooms, photos, description — and publishing directly from the phone compresses a two-day cycle into the appointment itself, which matters most in competitive markets where the first published listing gets the enquiries.
features: Mobile property capture with photos and details on site
Agency website module fed by the same catalogue
Digital signature on mandates and offers

use_cases.job: Capture and publish a new listing from the phone during the valuation visit
Run a multi-country European agency on one catalogue and one portal feed
